note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/e0067101/cash-bids?units=us — the site id e0067101 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://www.allied.coop/grain/cash-bids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (25495) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. One run said floor-cent (4 testable rows, margin 4) and there is no second run to agree with it. A mode is a property of how they compute their board, so it needs the same answer on a different day's prices. Left off, the identity guard stays exact and a board that does not reconcile refuses loudly instead of publishing under a mode nobody established. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 4 row(s) for this location. COORDINATES came from geocodes/basis1st-list-2026-08-20.tsv, matched on operator AND town (Allied Cooperative / AUBURNDALE) — never on town alone, which pairs Ag-Land FS's Elmwood in Illinois with Alcivia's Elmwood in Wisconsin. That file's kept population was sampled against the Census geocoder and ArcGIS at a median of 123 m, with Allied's Hixton at 37 m. It is EVIDENCE AND NOT A FACT — README rule 1 — so check this pin against the operator's own published address before enabling. STATE AND ADDRESS READ, NOT INFERRED. Premier, Allied, Country Partners, Country Visions and Ag-Land FS each publish their own locations list; the state and street below were read off it on 2026-08-25 and not inferred from the operator's headquarters.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
